completeness_rule: Complete source directory reconciles its exact native ID census including duplicate crosswalk values; explicit bounded vote pagination reaches a nonempty short final page and all source-defined periods and distinct WP item identities reconcile. Stable complete rereads preserve every literal stored/query score and native member-group occurrence, including overlaps, blank collections and identifier-only references. Annual reported-query cohort is separate from complete vote records; no inferred annual missing scores, official votes, weights or reproduced formula.
qualification_boundary: Named source rendition; remaining editions and renditions stay in scope
